name: Espresso
siboNotes: Black espresso is FODMAP-free and generally well-tolerated in SIBO. Caffeine may stimulate gut motility, which can be beneficial for some SIBO patients.
preparationTips: Drink black without milk or sweeteners to keep FODMAP-free
Limit to 2-3 shots per day to avoid excessive caffeine
Choose quality beans for better flavor without additives
Avoid flavored syrups which often contain high-FODMAP ingredients
nutritionalHighlights: Rich in antioxidants and chlorogenic acids
May support metabolism and fat oxidation
